notes.title: Added a Font Size Slider
notes.content: People playing on Steam Deck are having a hard time with the font size on some ui elements. So I added a font size slider to increase the size of some important fonts. This will not increase the size of all fonts. Increasing the font size may cause the UI to look bad/overlap.
